vien_co_yen.add: She has flogged two guards at the long table on a hunch that their cups were meant for Dạ Quang, and was right about one of them.

tong_thoi_kim.wants: One blade he can call finished before his hands fail, and a hall that never has to draw it in the head's war.
tong_thoi_kim.secret: He tempers every tenth blade of the hall's war order a hair too soft, and has told no one, so that Viên Cô Yên's war would break its own swords in the first week.

bang_tran_nhac.wants: To keep the hall from war until his wife's hair is white, and then walk the Hồi Lan road with her unarmed.
bang_tran_nhac.secret: He sends Ô Liệt Phong the hall's rota two days ahead, by Cam Thiết Bình's hand and behind his wife's back, so that the one honest Dạ Quang train never meets a trap of Viên Cô Yên's making.

nhiep_co_dang.wants: To end her days at a lamp's distance from the one honest man on the road, and never to write the last page of the watch.
nhiep_co_dang.secret: She keeps two watch-books: the true one, which clears Ô Liệt Phong, and the one she carries to Viên Cô Yên, which still suspects him, so the watch is never ended.
nhiep_co_dang.add: She has not shown the true book to anyone.

vo_kinh_son.add: He charges the younger strikers a copper for a turn at the big hammer.
vo_kinh_son.app: A left thumbnail gone black from a missed strike, and a laugh that rattles the tongs.

me_tieu_chuy.app: Soot in the creases of both ears and a walk that keeps the bellows' beat.

vi_sa_yen.app: A front tooth knocked out by a ram, which she shows off as a trophy.

vien_tieu_yen.add: She cannot sit through a night watch, and has been moved off three.
vien_tieu_yen.app: Ink under her fingernails from letters written by the last lamp.

cam_thiet_binh.app: Salt-cracked heels and a shield strap he has worn through twice.

dam_tri_ma.add: He swears at every stop that he has seen the raiders' faces; he has not.
dam_tri_ma.app: A horsehair braid at his collar and a voice that carries a li.

sub: A forge-hand's son, he has been Tống Thối Kim's (tong_thoi_kim) senior striker
la_doan_cuong.app: Missing the last two fingers of his left hand, which he calls his tithe.

ninh_ha_vien.add: He keeps a file on every head of the hall and would hand it to the Pavilion the day it paid.
ninh_ha_vien.app: He counts under his breath, even the steps of a stair.

la_tinh_nhi.add: The bellows tire her arms, and she works them anyway.
la_tinh_nhi.app: Eyebrows shaved to stubble, one nicked into a permanent question.

o_sa_ho.add: When she was thrown at a halt he rode past without turning his head.
o_sa_ho.app: A nose broken twice and set once.

nghiem_sa_lo.add: A foundling left at the Đà Linh well, she writes a rider's name into the watch book on a whim and strikes it out the same way.
nghiem_sa_lo.app: Chewed pen-ends tucked behind both ears.

khuc_dang_ha.app: Wax-yellow fingertips from the lamp trade.

cam_diem_nhi.app: Salt-white scars across both palms from the pans.
